name: S D PRAJWAL DEV
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A versatile player with a solid serve and aggressive baseline game, effective in both singles and doubles on hard courts.
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ATP Challenger Titles: Won 1 Challenger doubles title at the 2023 Astana Challenger with Niki Poonacha. ITF Success: Secured 2 ITF Futures singles titles (2022 M15 Colombo, 2023 M15 Jakarta) and 7 doubles titles. Biggest Singles Win: Defeated World No. 551 Woobin Shin at the 2025 ITF M15 Ahmedabad SF. Davis Cup & National Representation: Represented India in Junior Davis Cup (2012) but yet to debut in senior Davis Cup.
Other Highlights: Reached the semifinals of the 2025 ITF M15 Ahmedabad, showcasing a strong start to the year. Karnataka’s top-ranked player in 2023, earning a wildcard into the 2023 Bengaluru Open Challenger. Aims to break into the Top 300 in singles by 2026.
Prajwal is a rising talent in Indian tennis, balancing singles and doubles with consistent ITF success. 🎾🇮🇳 🎾🇮🇳
